personality_one_liner: Professional, data-dense, and highly readable utility with clear hierarchy and comfortable spacing for field operations.

spacing.rule: Generous comfortable padding for touch targets, avoid cramming despite data density.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Role-based entry point for Admin and Salesman with a professional logistics backdrop.

states.error: Inline text below fields, shake animation on input.

screens.layout: Hero image (Warehouse) occupying top 40% with a gradient scrim bottom-to-top. Bottom 60% holds a clean white surface card with role toggle (segmented control) and Email/Password fields. Primary Login CTA sticky above keyboard.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of daily field performance and outstanding dues.
screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top section: 2-column grid for key metrics (Today's Visits, Total Customers, Active Salesmen, Outstanding). Use 'brandTertiary' background for the Outstanding Dues card to highlight it. Middle section: 'Live Tracking' map snapshot. Bottom section: List of recent visits.

screens.name: Customer List
screens.purpose: Directory of all shops with search and filter capabilities.

states.empty: Empty box illustration, 'No customers found', 'Add Customer' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with Search Bar and Filter row (Area/Status). Flat list of customers. Each card shows Shop Name, Area, and an 'Outstanding' badge if applicable. A floating action button (FAB) for 'Add Customer'.

screens.name: Customer Details
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of a specific shop including quick actions.
screens.layout: Top: Shop photo banner with gradient scrim and Shop Name overlay. Below banner: Horizontal scroll of quick action pills (WhatsApp, Call, Map). Main content: Tabs or grouped sections (Details, Visits Log, Orders, Outstanding). Floating CTA: 'Log Visit' pinned at bottom.

screens.name: Add/Edit Customer Form
screens.purpose: Data entry screen for adding a new shop, capturing GPS and photos.
screens.layout: Single column form inside a KeyboardAvoidingView. Image picker placeholders for 'Shop Photo' and 'Visiting Card' at the top. GPS field with 'Fetch Current Location' button. Sticky 'Save Customer' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Log a Visit
screens.purpose: Quick workflow for a salesman to record an interaction.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet or modal. Auto-fetches current GPS. Fields: Outcome (segmented control: Order, No Order, Follow-up), Order Amount (if applicable), Remarks, Next Follow-up Date. Primary CTA to submit.

screens.name: Route Map
screens.purpose: Visual plotting of salesman locations and visits.

states.empty: Map centered with no pins, toast 'No visits today'.

screens.layout: Full screen react-native-maps view. Top safe area has a floating glass header to select Salesman and Date. Bottom 30% has a draggable Bottom Sheet listing the sequence of visits. Map shows numbered pins and a polyline connecting them.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use any blue or purple shades for primary actions or info states.
Implement the gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) over the login hero image to ensure text readability.
For the Map UI, use `react-native-maps`. Keep the map clean, using the specified map_pins image or standard high-contrast markers.
When integrating WhatsApp, use deep linking `Linking.openURL('whatsapp://send?phone=...')` combined with a prefilled template.
Ensure the 'Outstanding Amount' is highly visible; use the `error` (#BE123C) color text when a customer owes money to draw attention.
Always pin primary CTAs (like 'Log Visit' and 'Save') to the bottom of the screen with proper safe-area padding so they are thumb-accessible.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all tabs and actions. Keep weight identical.
Adhere strictly to <Anti_Patterns>. Avoid default headers and ensure 44x44pt touch targets for all interactive elements.
